title: News on iOS 27 Beta 5: Icons and Messages Changes
description: Reports indicate new icons for Siri and Safari in iOS 27 Beta 5, while changes to the Messages app and Apple One Premier are also discussed.

sections.heading: Visual Updates in Beta 5
paragraphs: According to MacRumors, iOS 27 Beta 5 brings new icons for several applications. The source specifically mentions updates for Siri, Safari, and Settings, among others.

sections.heading: Messages App Changes
paragraphs: KPTV reports that big changes are coming for iPhone users in the Messages app. The source indicates that these updates will alter the user experience, noting what users can expect from the changes.

sections.heading: Apple One Premier Features
paragraphs: AOL.com reports that Apple One Premier is getting two new features in iOS 27. The article describes these additions as notable updates for the service.
